---
agent: agent
description: Continue the current phase/part after a quota cut-off or a new chat
---
Follow `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

Read `docs/PROGRESS.md` and `docs/DECISIONS.md`, inspect `git status`, `git log --oneline -20` and the current branch, and work out exactly where the last session stopped (including any half-written files or uncommitted changes). Report that state to the owner in two or three Vietnamese sentences, then continue the current phase/part from that point to completion, following the same prompt file of that phase. Do not redo finished work; do not start the next phase.
